finding_key: packages/frontend/src/components/login-form.tsx::new login-error ui (login_errors map + generic fallback + page wiring of ?error=) has no test at all
evidence: The diff is stated to be the whole change, and it adds substantial tests on the backend (cli-login-confirm.middleware.spec.ts, github-auth.guard.spec.ts, github.strategy.spec.ts, auth.controller.spec.ts additions) and CLI side (login.test.ts, login-command.test.ts, status.test.ts, etc.) but touches no frontend test file at all. The new user-visible half — `error` prop, `LOGIN_ERRORS` map with the `oauth_state` key, `GENERIC_LOGIN_ERROR` fallback and the `role="alert"` paragraph in packages/frontend/src/components/login-form.tsx, plus `useSearchParams().get("error")` wiring in app/login/page.tsx — is brand-new behaviour, so no pre-existing test could exercise it either. That matches the claim: a misspelled `oauth_state` key or a dropped prop would silently degrade the retry message with a green suite. Severity is minor: it is a presentational/UX branch, and the security property (no session issued) is asserted in auth.controller.spec.ts; I could not grep packages/frontend/tests to confirm the cited theme-provider test exists, but that only affects the "testable area" argument, not the omission itself.
